execution_environment.network_policy: No data sent to any server
execution_environment.dependencies: Zero external dependencies, zero CDN, zero analytics, zero third-party telemetry
execution_environment.runtime_requirement: Standard Web Browser with native WebCrypto API

cryptography.secret_sharing: Shamir Secret Sharing over GF(2^8) (Lagrange interpolation)
cryptography.integrity_verification: SHA-256 pre-encryption digest matched bit-for-bit upon recovery
cryptography.merkle_integrity: Local Merkle root binding document digest and initialization vector

physical_artifacts.error_detection: 8-character real-time keystroke checksum with character position locator

not_provided: No centralized key recovery or cloud backup
No certified legal eIDAS qualification (operates as a private technical custody and cryptographic proof artifact)
Arbitrary quorums (>3 shares) or larger payloads (>10 MB) require explicit client configuration and hardware memory
